adjudication_records.issue_text: RunCommands is an unimplemented stub that always errors, preventing TablesList from parsing SQL table references

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that sql/db.go introduces a new DB struct with RunCommands method that always returns an error ('not implemented'). The parser.go file is modified to use this new NewInMemoryDB() instead of duck.NewInMemoryDB(). The TablesList function in parser.go calls duckDB.RunCommands(), which will now always fail with 'not implemented' error, breaking the SQL table parsing functionality. This is a real defect where the stub implementation prevents the feature from working.
